symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The number of values a digit can take, equal to 2 raised to the digit width b.
symbols.quote: The radix is $Q_0 = 2^b$, the number of values a digit can take, which is the base in which each digit is written.

symbols.name: output digit
symbols.meaning: The j-th base-Q_0 digit of the output, an integer from 0 to Q_0 minus 1.
symbols.quote: The digit $d_j$ is the $j$th base-$Q_0$ digit of the output, so $0 \le d_j < Q_0$.

symbols.name: carry
symbols.meaning: The amount carried into position j from the lower positions.
symbols.quote: The carry $\gamma_j$ is the amount carried into position $j$ from the lower positions.

symbols.name: summed position
symbols.meaning: The position of an already processed coefficient, running over the summation range 0 to j minus 1.
symbols.quote: Why this keeps the value: here $h$ is a summation index, the position of an already processed coefficient, running over $0 \le h < j$.

relations.quote: Carry propagation takes its input from [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md): the output is the list of integer coefficients $c_0, c_1, \dots$ of the product of the two digit polynomials.
